name: Oura Ring
description: Oura Ring BLE advertising fingerprint. Decodes mode, hardware, color, size, and design from company 0x02B2 manufacturer payload.
author: BLESPloit
notes: Decoded from Oura Android ourakit RingScanRecord. Manufacturer payload (after company id 690/0x02B2): [version][hw_hi|mode_lo][color_hi|size_lo][design_lo]. Mode bits (version>=4): bit0 factory reset, bit1 in charger, bit2 pairing.
